source_prompt: I want it so the minutes ONLY tells me the attendees, nothing else, in a table.

sections.name: Attendees
sections.description: List all meeting attendees in a markdown table with two columns: 'Name' and 'Role' (leave Role blank if unknown). Include every person who spoke or was explicitly mentioned as present. Do not add any other information.

template.extra_rules: The minutes must contain only the attendees table. Do not add summaries, context, decisions, notes, or any other content beyond what is in the defined sections.
